requirements: Preserve exact quota-v2 contract and limits through immutable plan refresh.
Publishing refreshed plans cannot reset a running ledger or revive old authority.
A refreshed profile starts only with an explicit new run, fresh exact Ask and unchanged finite ceilings.
Retained typed quota counters remain local bookkeeping, never authenticated commit or delivery proof.
diagnostic_composition: Actual refreshed quota-v2 run with fresh Ask; default and explicit output-check diagnosis must preserve private state, outputs and sentinel, and retain indeterminate commit/delivery/model claims.
